items.description: R1 [Improvement — ANS-101]: "Retire modern-app-dev and modern-app-dev-playwright: move their pipelines to the kube-coder toolchain images or purpose-built ones … Done when nothing outside DockerImages references either image, the two directories are removed, the `modern_app_dev` template is gone from JenkinsPipelineUtils, and the registry repos are deleted." Holds when V02–V13 hold, with rulings D1–D3, Q1 and the settled list as recorded in plan.md.

"Move their pipelines to the kube-coder toolchain images": KubeCoder's Validate and contracts drift gate stages (today `KubeCoder/Jenkinsfile:11,37,70`) and FieldnotesApp's Validate stage (today `FieldnotesApp/Jenkinsfile:12,26` at b6a5016) run in `registry:5000/kube-coder-modern-app-toolchain:node-24` through a new `containerTemplates` entry beside `iac_toolchain` (`JenkinsPipelineUtils/vars/containerTemplates.groovy:46`); HomelabTerraformProvider's publish container (today `HomelabTerraformProvider/Jenkinsfile:5`) comes from `containerTemplates.iac_toolchain`.

"Move their pipelines to the kube-coder toolchain images" (ruling D1): the DHCPApp, ElectronicsInventory, IoTSupport and ZigbeeControl validation Jobs (today `DHCPApp/Jenkinsfile:25` at 3f32870, `ElectronicsInventory/Jenkinsfile:30` at 819a6475, `IoTSupport/Jenkinsfile:25` at bfe20c4, `ZigbeeControl/Jenkinsfile:25` at 8043c1a, all generated from ModernAppTemplate's `root/template/Jenkinsfile.jinja:25` at acfc588) run in `kube-coder-modern-app-toolchain:node-24`; the lockfile-derived `playwright-<version>` image tag is gone, and Chromium is downloaded at test time by the suite runner (`tools/suite_runner/local.py:239` in each app, from `root/template/tools/suite_runner/local.py.jinja:239`). No purpose-built Playwright image exists.

Ruling D1's two premises are proven by the first app's phase on a real Jenkins build before the other apps follow: that build's validation Job pod reached Playwright's browser download host and downloaded Chromium, and the app's frontend built and tested on Node 24. The first app's done-record names the build.

Every moved consumer has a green Jenkins build on its moved pipeline — KubeCoder (`KubeCoder/Build-Main`), FieldnotesApp, HomelabTerraformProvider, DHCPApp, ElectronicsInventory, IoTSupport and ZigbeeControl — each pushed and proven before `modern_app_dev` leaves JenkinsPipelineUtils and the two directories leave DockerImages.

No coverage is lost: every moved stage runs the same checks it ran on modern-app-dev or modern-app-dev-playwright — KubeCoder's lint, tests and contracts drift gate (the `npm ci` runs still feeding the later extension stages), FieldnotesApp's lint and tests against a real `git`, and each app's backend and frontend validation suites, Playwright included.

"Nothing outside DockerImages references either image", read over live pipelines, scaffolds, and current docs, runbooks and code comments (the settled reading), with DesignAssistant excepted (ruling D2). Historical records keep their mentions: completed slices, archived triage documents, dated reviews and audits, ModernAppTemplate's changelog entries (ruling Q1), and records that cite this slice by name. At re-grounding (2026-09-26, each repo's pushed `main`) the live references outside DockerImages were the three `modern_app_dev` callers of V02, the four apps' and the root template's hardcoded Playwright images of V03, the pre-baked-browser comments the root template generates into the apps (`root/template/Jenkinsfile.jinja:19-20`, `root/template/tools/suite_runner/local.py.jinja:235-236`) and `ModernAppTemplate/docs/copier_approach.md:74`, plus `HomelabTerraformProvider/README.md:16`, `scripts/fetch-install.sh:3`, `scripts/install-local.sh:3`, `Jenkinsfile:76`; `KubeCoder/docs/operations/ci-gates.md:55`, `pipeline-dependencies.md:16,40`; `FieldnotesApp/Jenkinsfile:6`; `AnsibleSpecs/decisions.md:58`; `Ansible/docs/runbooks/step-ca-root-rotation.md:116,164`, `docs/runbooks/operator-workstation.md:93`, `support/iac-image/Dockerfile:102`, `terraform/modules/managed-vm/versions.tf:10`; `ArgoCDTools/argocd-hook/Dockerfile:30`. ModernAppFrontendTemplate and ModernAppBackendTemplate carry none: their per-repo CI left them with Frontend v0.20.0 and Backend v0.13.0 (ModernAppFrontendTemplate `032f366`).

"The two directories are removed": DockerImages has no `modern-app-dev/` or `modern-app-dev-playwright/`, so neither image is built any more, on push or on the weekly poll (images are found by directory, `DockerImages/tools/dockerfile_deps.py:21`). DockerImages' own current text no longer names either as a live image (`kube-coder-iac-toolchain/Dockerfile:77` at planning).
"The `modern_app_dev` template is gone from JenkinsPipelineUtils" (`vars/containerTemplates.groovy:89-90` at planning), and the library's modern-app toolchain template that replaces it is present.

DockerImages' `docs/registry-management/` carries the short procedure ruling D3 names: a repository's tags deleted through the registry API and its entry removed from registry storage, with no manual garbage collect. The procedure matches the registry as RegistryDeploy deploys it (storage backend, delete setting).

"The registry repos are deleted": neither `modern-app-dev` nor `modern-app-dev-playwright` is in `registry:5000`'s catalog, both removed by the operator through the V10 procedure only after every moved consumer had a green build (V05); no garbage collect was run for it.
items.owed_after: the operator's registry deletion (ruling D3), after the run, following the procedure P12 adds

items.description: DesignAssistant is not part of the work (ruling D2): the slice changes nothing in it, and its references (its `Jenkinsfile` on `main` and `develop`, `tools/suite_runner/remote.py`) stay.

The image change lands in ModernAppTemplate's root template as a new release, and each app takes it with `copier update` at its root, so a later update never puts the old image back (ruling Q1): the root template (`root/template/Jenkinsfile.jinja`, `root/template/tools/suite_runner/local.py.jinja`, at acfc588 still on modern-app-dev-playwright and a pre-baked browser) references neither image; the release is tagged and on ModernAppTemplate's origin; each of the four apps' root `.copier-answers.yml` names it (today `_commit: v0.1.1`) and its `Jenkinsfile` and suite runner match what it generates. ModernAppTemplate's current docs that describe the validation image are corrected (`docs/copier_approach.md:74` today); its historical changelog entries stay.
